entries.c9b8e38eadc99187: The company is a general retailer headquartered in Kashiwa, Chiba Prefecture. Together with three consolidated subsidiaries (Spiral Co., Ltd., Shonisawa Beverage Co., Ltd. and Sanmoru Co., Ltd.), its main business is general retail of frequently purchased essential household goods, and it also partly operates franchises. Spiral is responsible for procuring group products, Shonisawa Beverage for manufacturing the original product 'Shonisawa no Tennensui', and Sanmoru for operating six food supermarkets centered on Numata, Gunma Prefecture. In addition to product sales, other operating income, including royalties and tenant rent, was ¥1,030 million in the fiscal year ended February 2026. The number of employees as of February 28, 2026 was 181. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
